articles.title: Midterm Reckoning: UK Local Elections Could Redraw Political Map as Starmer Fights for Survival
articles.summary: Millions of Britons voted Thursday in local elections seen as a referendum on Prime Minister Keir Starmer. Labour braces for heavy losses, while hard-right Reform UK and the Greens surge. One analyst predicts the "total collapse" of the traditional two-party system. Results could trigger a leadership challenge.

articles.title: Treasury Targets Iraqi Deputy Oil Minister, Accusing Him of Orchestrating Iran's Shadow Oil Trade
articles.summary: The US sanctioned Iraq's Deputy Oil Minister Ali Maarij al-Bahadly and militia leaders, alleging they helped Iran evade sanctions and smuggle oil worth at least $1 billion annually. The move escalates the Trump administration's "maximum pressure" campaign amid the ongoing conflict over the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: NPR Podcast Winner Turns a Grandson's Fear of Dementia into an Intimate Audio Letter
articles.summary: Colby McCaskill, 21, won NPR's College Podcast Challenge with an audio letter to his grandfather about his grandmother's dementia. The episode captures raw, unflinching conversations and has moved his family to tears. "It's like a warm hug," Colby says of his grandparents.
